facts.claim: 1914년 11월 3일 새로 생긴 'brassieres' 특허 분류의 첫 특허가 메리 펠프스 제이컵에게(뒷날 카레스 크로스비)
facts.note: On 3 November 1914, the newly formed US patent category for "brassieres" was inaugurated with the first patent issued to Mary Phelps Jacob, later and better known as Caresse Crosby.
In 1914, the first modern bra was patented by New York publisher, activist, and socialite Caresse Crosby (born Mary Phelps Jacob).

facts.claim: 보스턴의 두 사람 공장에서 잠깐 만들다 워너 브러더스 코르셋 회사에 특허를 팔았다
facts.note: After patenting her design in 1914, she briefly manufactured bras at a two-woman factory in Boston, before selling her patent to the Warner Brothers Corset Company, which began mass-producing the garment.

question.hintNote: She told her, "Bring me two of my pocket handkerchiefs and some pink ribbon …" She fashioned the handkerchiefs and ribbon into a simple bra.

facts.claim: 'sneaker' 는 흔히 N. W. 에이어 앤드 선의 광고인 매킨리가 1917년 쓴 것으로 알려져 있다
facts.note: The word "sneaker" is often attributed to American Henry Nelson McKinney, who was an advertising agent for N. W. Ayer & Son. In 1917, he used the term because the rubber sole made the shoe's wearer stealthy.

facts.claim: 1887년 보스턴 저널에 '남자아이들이 테니스화에 붙인 이름' 으로 실렸다
facts.note: The word was already in use at least as early as 1887, when the Boston Journal made reference to "sneakers" as "the name boys give to tennis shoes."

facts.claim: 고무 밑창이 조용하다는 데서 온 이름, 가죽 밑창 구두와 대비
facts.note: The name "sneakers" originally referred to how quiet the rubber soles were on the ground, in contrast to noisy standard hard leather sole dress shoes.

question.hintNote: market for sneakers grew steadily as young boys lined up to buy Converse All Stars sneakers endorsed by basketball player Chuck Taylor.
question.easiestCue: 1917년 미국 광고 회사 N. W. 에이어 앤드 선의 광고인 헨리 넬슨 매킨리가 처음 썼다고 흔히 알려진 신발 이름
